verdict.rationale: Grafana Alerting supports querying/alerting across many data sources with consolidated management, and Grafana Cloud adds on-call scheduling, escalation, and incident coordination (routing/grouping analog to Alertmanager). SLO features let SREs define SLIs/SLOs to alert on reliability signals, and community evidence confirms multi-datasource alerting works in production (albeit with added complexity from needing separate services like Alertmanager). Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of silencing/grouping mechanics and independent confirmation of routing granularity beyond general alerting docs.
